code: games <- lic_tidy_games(raw_games, username = "h8gi")  games %>%   select(id, created_at, user_color, user_result, user_rating, opponent_name, opening.name) %>%   head()

what: R Client and Analysis Tools for Lichess
title: R Client and Analysis Tools for Lichess
text: rlichess modern, tidy R client Lichess API. provides tools fetching, standardizing, analyzing chess games, opening repertoires, user profiles, rating histories, puzzles using tidyverse conventions.

title: R Client and Analysis Tools for Lichess
text: Tidy Game Data: Fetch user games (NDJSON stream) convert tidy tibbles user-perspective columns (user_color, user_result, user_rating, opponent_name, created_at). Move--Move Expansion: Unpack game move sequences, clock times, Stockfish evaluations long-format tibbles (1 row per half-move). Opening Analysis & Explorer: Calculate opening win rates query Lichess/Masters Opening Explorer databases directly R. User & Rating Analytics: Retrieve user performance profiles, detailed statistics, daily rating histories. Included Dataset: Built-lichess_openings dataset containing 3,378 ECO codes, opening names, PGN move sequences. Robust Networking: Powered httr2 automatic retry, rate limiting, friendly error messages.

title: R Client and Analysis Tools for Lichess
text: Install development version GitHub:
code: # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("h8gi/rlichess")  # or using devtools / remotes devtools::install_github("h8gi/rlichess")

title: R Client and Analysis Tools for Lichess
text: public endpoints can accessed anonymously, providing Lichess Personal Access Token increases rate limits enables -demand rating history retrieval. Set token .Renviron: R, rlichess automatically loads via lic_token():

title: R Client and Analysis Tools for Lichess
code: library(rlichess) library(dplyr)  # 1. Download games (supports date filtering, clocks, evals) raw_games <- lic_get_games(   username = "h8gi",   perf_type = "bullet",   since = "2025-01-01",   max = 50,   clocks = TRUE,   evals = TRUE )  # 2. Tidy into user-centric format (win/loss, dates, opponent info) games <- lic_tidy_games(raw_games, username = "h8gi")  # 3. Unpack moves into long format (1 row per half-move) moves_df <- lic_tidy_moves(games) head(moves_df)  # 4. Calculate opening win rates opening_stats <- lic_stats_openings(games, min_games = 5) head(opening_stats)

title: R Client and Analysis Tools for Lichess
code: # Summary of ratings across performance categories perfs <- lic_user_perfs("h8gi")  # Daily rating history (returns a tidy tibble of dates and ratings) history <- lic_rating_history("h8gi", perf_type = "bullet")  # Detailed stats (streaks, best wins, worst losses, average opponent) stats <- lic_user_perf_stats("h8gi", perf = "bullet")

title: R Client and Analysis Tools for Lichess
code: # Query Lichess opening database for candidate moves (e.g. 1. e4 c5) explorer <- lic_opening_explorer(play = "e4,c5") explorer$moves  # Query FIDE master games (2200+ FIDE) masters <- lic_masters_explorer(play = "e4,c5") masters$moves
